svg.text: concept sheet · labels are sheet notes, not part of the art
Village map, 1680 × 944 source (shown 2/3). Eight buildings, paths to the Town Square, no text.
Workshop room, 1400 × 787: one bench per game (6 today), blank plates
Town Hall room, 1400 × 787: lower third kept calm for titles
Idea: crisp dark ink lines over soft watercolor washes on cream paper, a cozy storybook village at dusk.
Risk: the wash texture can drift back toward the 'blurry and mushy' look unless the ink stays heavy and the washes stay inside it.
